title: Jiggly Fried Galician Eggs Fritters
description: A traditional Galician breakfast dish featuring earthy, fried egg rolls. These Galician fritters are perfect for hangover cures due to their rich, savory flavor and satisfying crunch.
instructions: Mix eggs in a large bowl and season with salt and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, combine flour and bread crumbs.
Add the dry mixture to the eggs and mix until just combined.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the egg mixture into the skillet.
Use a spatula to shape the egg mixture into a round and flat shape.
Cook the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer the fritters to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Sprinkle with garlic and parsley before serving.
